TerminalName: Dar es Salaam Small-Scale LNG Terminal
OtherNames: Rosetta Energy LNG Virtual Pipeline; Tanzania LNG Virtual Pipeline
Owner: Rosetta Energy Solutions; Tanzania Petroleum Development Corp; Africa50
ResearcherNotesProject: Tanzania's first small-scale LNG 'virtual pipeline': a small-scale liquefaction plant in Dar es Salaam feeding cryogenic road-tanker containers to regasification plants near customers (e.g. Elsewedy Industrial City ~100 km away). Sponsor Rosetta Energy Solutions (subsidiary of Egypt's TAQA Arabia) signed a Heads of Terms agreement with TPDC and Africa50 in May 2024 (sources give 22 May / 31 May). Reported ownership split in some coverage: Rosetta 44% / Africa50 26% / TPDC 30% (single-source, not corroborated -> left out of Owner percentages). Target investment >$100M; potential construction start as early as 2025. Liquefaction capacity (MTPA/tpd) not disclosed -> left blank. FacilityType set 'export' (small-scale liquefaction); reviewer may prefer a small-scale/peakshaving classification per methodology. ProposalMonth=5 (May 2024 HoT).
